      dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">rgya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note>  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> don dam par rang bzhin med par ma <lb n="18b5"/>  grub na <note type="gloss"> dngos 'gal la gcig shos bkag pa nyid gcig shos grub pa yin pas</note> <lb n="18b5"/> bden dngos grub par 'gyur zhing | rig shes la yul dang gzhal bya med pas shes pa dang tshad ma ma yin par 'gyur ba dang| 
      <note type="gloss">ri rwa nyid med pas de 'jal byed kyi blo'am tshad ma med pa bzhin </note> 
      don dam par rang bzhin med par smra ba'i rang tshig dang 'gal ba dang | 
      chos thams cad stong nyid du ston pa'i lung dang 'gal lo zhes smra ba la de ni 'di snyam du dpyad de | </seg></TEI>
